    "import warnings\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "pd.options.mode.chained_assignment = None"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4e66398b735014f3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# sctrial: Stress Test and Scalability Analysis\n",
    "\n",
    "This notebook demonstrates `sctrial`'s performance and scalability by running a stress test on a large-scale synthetic dataset (e.g., 20,000 cells and 10,000 genes).\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "efe0acb88e51a7b0",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-01-03T02:17:40.549150Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-01-03T02:17:40.549050Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-01-03T02:17:41.560882Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-01-03T02:17:41.560454Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import sctrial as st\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "from anndata import AnnData\n",
    "from scipy import sparse\n",
    "import time\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "60549085a96a3d70",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 1. Dataset Generation\n",
    "We generate a dataset with 50 participants and 10,000 genes to simulate the scale of a real clinical trial.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "d4a4831cfc538d6a",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-01-03T02:17:41.562735Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-01-03T02:17:41.562558Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-01-03T02:17:44.449862Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-01-03T02:17:44.449354Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Generating stress-test dataset: 50 participants, 10000 genes...\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "AnnData object with n_obs × n_vars = 20000 × 10000\n",
      "    obs: 'participant_id', 'visit', 'arm', 'celltype', 'batch'\n",
      "    layers: 'counts'\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "n_participants = 50\n",
    "n_cells_per_unit = 200\n",
    "n_genes = 10000\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Generating stress-test dataset: {n_participants} participants, {n_genes} genes...\")\n",
    "\n",
    "rows = []\n",
    "for i in range(n_participants):\n",
    "    arm = \"Treated\" if i < n_participants // 2 else \"Control\"\n",
    "    for v in [\"Baseline\", \"Followup\"]:\n",
    "        for _ in range(n_cells_per_unit):\n",
    "            rows.append({\n",
    "                \"participant_id\": f\"P{i}\",\n",
    "                \"visit\": v,\n",
    "                \"arm\": arm,\n",
    "                \"celltype\": \"TypeA\" if np.random.rand() > 0.5 else \"TypeB\",\n",
    "                \"batch\": f\"B{i % 5}\"\n",
    "            })\n",
    "\n",
    "obs = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n",
    "n_obs = len(obs)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Generate sparse noisy data\n",
    "data = np.random.poisson(0.1, size=(n_obs, n_genes)).astype(float)\n",
    "# Inject signal in some genes\n",
    "data[obs[(obs[\"arm\"]==\"Treated\") & (obs[\"visit\"]==\"Followup\")].index, :10] += 2.0\n",
    "X = sparse.csr_matrix(data)\n",
    "\n",
    "adata = AnnData(X=X, obs=obs)\n",
    "adata.var_names = [f\"Gene{i}\" for i in range(n_genes)]\n",
    "adata.layers[\"counts\"] = adata.X.copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "print(adata)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ff81aff2f4d25ffb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 2. Benchmark: Normalization\n",
    "We measure the time taken to normalize 20,000 cells x 10,000 genes.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "2f983aeaa0ffcd1f",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-01-03T02:17:44.451189Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-01-03T02:17:44.451099Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-01-03T02:17:44.669325Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-01-03T02:17:44.668848Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Normalizing...\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Done in 0.22s\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "design = st.TrialDesign(\n",
    "    participant_col=\"participant_id\",\n",
    "    visit_col=\"visit\",\n",
    "    arm_col=\"arm\",\n",
    "    arm_treated=\"Treated\",\n",
    "    arm_control=\"Control\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Normalizing...\")\n",
    "start_norm = time.time()\n",
    "adata = st.add_log1p_cpm_layer(adata, counts_layer=\"counts\", out_layer=\"log1p_cpm\")\n",
    "time_norm = time.time() - start_norm\n",
    "print(f\"Done in {time_norm:.2f}s\")\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fbf900202b7f5808",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 3. Benchmark: Large-Scale DiD Analysis\n",
    "We run DiD across a range of gene counts to evaluate scaling behavior.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "6efc1bb3eb870d1b",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-01-03T02:17:44.670692Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-01-03T02:17:44.670610Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-01-03T02:17:49.029085Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-01-03T02:17:49.028578Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Running DiD on 10 genes...\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Running DiD on 50 genes...\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Running DiD on 100 genes...\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Running DiD on 200 genes...\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "gene_counts = [10, 50, 100, 200]\n",
    "times = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for gc in gene_counts:\n",
    "    print(f\"Running DiD on {gc} genes...\")\n",
    "    start = time.time()\n",
    "    _ = st.did_table(\n",
    "        adata, \n",
    "        features=adata.var_names[:gc], \n",
    "        design=design, \n",
    "        visits=(\"Baseline\", \"Followup\"),\n",
    "        layer=\"log1p_cpm\"\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    times.append(time.time() - start)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
    "plt.plot(gene_counts, times, marker='o', linestyle='-', color='firebrick')\n",
    "plt.title(\"Scaling Behavior: DiD Execution Time\")\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"Number of Genes\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"Time (seconds)\")\n",
    "plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {

   "id": "8456dd290880607c",

     ]

   ],
   "source": [
    "print(\"Running stratified DiD (10 genes x 2 celltypes)...\")\n",
    "start_strat = time.time()\n",
    "strat_res = st.did_table_by_celltype(\n",
    "    adata,\n",
    "    features=adata.var_names[:10],\n",

   ]
  },

    "print(\"Running GSEA benchmark (10 pathways)...\")\n",
    "gene_sets_large = {f\"Pathway_{i}\": [f\"Gene{j}\" for j in range(i*10, (i+1)*10)] for i in range(10)}\n",
    "\n",
    "start_gsea = time.time()\n",
    "gsea_res = st.run_gsea_did(\n",
    "    adata, \n",
    "    gene_sets=gene_sets_large, \n",
    "    design=design, \n",
    "    visits=(\"Baseline\", \"Followup\"),\n",
    "    permutation_num=100,\n",
    "    min_size=1,\n",
    "    seed=42\n",
    ")\n",
    "time_gsea = time.time() - start_gsea\n",
    "print(f\"Done in {time_gsea:.2f}s\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Plot GSEA results\n",
    "st.plot_gsea_heatmap(gsea_res, fdr_thresh=1.0, figsize=(10, 8))\n",
    "plt.title(\"GSEA Heatmap (Stress Test)\", fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
